# LaplandFood

> A field guide to Finnish food culture: where the ingredients come from, what the recipes taste like, the Michelin scene and food tours in Lapland.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandfood.com/): How Finland eats: recipes, Michelin and tours
- [Local Ingredients](https://laplandfood.com/local-ingredients): Where Lapland's ingredients come from
- [Finnish Berries](https://laplandfood.com/berries): The four wild berries of the Finnish kitchen, with a guide for each
- [Cloudberry](https://laplandfood.com/cloudberry): The Arctic berry no one can farm
- [Bilberry](https://laplandfood.com/bilberry): Finland's wild blueberry and how it differs from the farmed one
- [Lingonberry](https://laplandfood.com/lingonberry): The tart red berry beside every reindeer plate
- [Sea Buckthorn](https://laplandfood.com/sea-buckthorn): The sour orange berry of the Bothnian coast
- [Traditional Recipes](https://laplandfood.com/traditional-recipes): Traditional Finnish and Lapland recipes
- [Poronkäristys, sautéed reindeer](https://laplandfood.com/poronkaristys): The reindeer herders' recipe, the oven method, prices and where to eat it in Lapland
- [Leipäjuusto, Finnish squeaky cheese](https://laplandfood.com/leipajuusto): Warm with cloudberry jam, in coffee or in a salad, and how to make it from milk
- [Modern Lapland](https://laplandfood.com/modern-lapland): Modern Lapland food scene
- [Foraging Guide](https://laplandfood.com/foraging-guide): Foraging berries, mushrooms and wild food
- [Food Tours](https://laplandfood.com/food-tours): Food tours in Lapland
- [Michelin Dining](https://laplandfood.com/michelin-dining): The Michelin scene in Finland and Lapland
- [About](https://laplandfood.com/about): About the site

## Languages

English (default, no prefix), Finnish (/fi/), Swedish (/sv/), German (/de/), French (/fr/), Spanish (/es/), Italian (/it/), Dutch (/nl/), Brazilian Portuguese (/br/), Japanese (/ja/), Korean (/kr/), Simplified Chinese (/cn/)
